svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: CI/CD from GitHub Actions to AWS
svg.desc: CI/CD from GitHub Actions to AWS. 7 components in 4 groups. Connections: Developer to Pull request (open); Pull request to GitHub Actions (merge to main); GitHub Actions to Global service (assume role with OIDC); GitHub Actions to Amazon ECR (push image); GitHub Actions to AWS CloudFormation (deploy); AWS CloudFormation to Amazon ECS (update service); Amazon ECR to Amazon ECS (pull image).

text.tspan: CI/CD FROM GITHUB ACTIONS TO AWS
A merge to main runs a workflow that assumes an IAM role, pushes the image and deploys the stack
